mapper.sql: id, contract_code, contract_name, account_period, client_code, client_name, org_id, account_code, account_name, lease_date_start, lease_date_end, business_code, business_name, account_category, currency_type, contract_balance, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, submit_by

select t.contract_code, t.client_code, t.org_id, t.bill_contract_code, max(id) id, sum(t.supplier_margin_amount) supplier_margin_balance, sum(t.payable_margin_amount) payable_margin_balance, sum(t.other_margin_amount) other_margin_balance, sum(t.lessee_margin_amount) lessee_margin_balance from (select id , contract_code , client_code , org_id , bill_contract_code , supplier_margin_amount , other_margin_amount , payable_margin_amount , lessee_margin_amount from eg_contract_balance where period_code = #{param.periodCode} union all select null id, contract_code, client_code, org_id, bill_contract_code, supplier_margin_balance supplier_margin_amount, payable_margin_balance other_margin_amount, other_margin_balance payable_margin_amount, lessee_margin_balance lessee_margin_amount from eg_contract_balance_month where period_code = #{param.lastPeriodCode}) t group by t.contract_code, t.client_code, t.org_id, t.bill_contract_code
mapper.select: select b.batch_id , a.org_id , a.balance_date , a.margin_type , a.account_code , a.account_name , a.business_date , a.finance_date , a.margin_status , a.is_generate_voucher , b.within_one_year_deposit , b.deposit_interest_expense , b.deposit_interest_income from eg_margin_contract_balance a, (select max(id) as id , batch_id , sum(within_one_year_deposit) within_one_year_deposit , sum(deposit_interest_expense) deposit_interest_expense , sum(deposit_interest_income) deposit_interest_income from eg_margin_contract_balance where del_flag = '0' and margin_type is not null and margin_status in ('2','3','4') and org_id = #{param.orgId} and account_code = #{param.accountCode} and to_char(business_date,'YYYY-MM') = #{param.businessDateMonth} and margin_type = #{param.marginType} group by batch_id) b where a.id = b.id and a.batch_id = b.batch_id limit 1

select t.contract_code, t.org_id, t.business_code, t.contract_name, t.lease_date_start, t.lease_date_end, t.business_name, t.currency_type, sum(t.supplier_margin_balance) as supplier_margin_balance, sum(t.payable_margin_balance) as payable_margin_balance, sum(t.other_margin_balance) as other_margin_balance, sum(t.lessee_margin_balance) as lessee_margin_balance from eg_margin_contract_balance_temp t where 1 = 1 group by t.contract_code, t.org_id, t.business_code, t.contract_name, t.lease_date_start, t.lease_date_end, t.business_name, t.currency_type
